outcome: Accuracy in skill operations (uterine displacement maneuvers, peripartum cesarean section decision-making, defibrillation, resuscitation drug administration)
Adherence to maternal cardiac arrest protocols
cohort: Sixty physicians participating in Maternal Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) training at the study hospital from October 2023 to December 2024.
finding: The modified Peyton's four-step teaching method significantly enhanced physicians' mastery of maternal ACLS skills, improved teamwork capabilities, and elevated both teaching quality and learner satisfaction, despite showing no significant difference in knowledge scores compared to traditional training.
